title: Usemi Halisi na Usemi wa Taarifa (Theme 15: Maadili ya kijamii)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 8 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child applies the rules of reporting: marks removed, kwamba/kuwa added (not before a question word), person, tense, time and place words changed, questions ending with a full stop.

floor.prerequisite: Changes person and tense when reporting.
floor.question: Badilisha: Juma alisema, "Nimechoka."

steps: Add kwamba (not before a question word).

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child writes "Mwalimu aliuliza kama tulikuwa tumemaliza kazi."

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni usemi upi ni wa taarifa?" Kwa nini "Baba alisema, "Nimechoka."" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Usemi wa taarifa hauna alama za usemi.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni usemi upi ni halisi?" Kwa nini "Baba alisema kwamba amechoka." si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Usemi halisi una alama za usemi.

listen_for: Juma alisema kwamba mimi ni mgonjwa.
misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Juma alisema, "Mimi ni mgonjwa." Taarifa ni ipi?" Kwa nini "Juma alisema kwamba mimi ni mgonjwa." si jibu sahihi?
Sentensi ya taarifa ni swali tena?
misconceptions.repair: Swali katika usemi wa taarifa huishia kwa kikomo: Mama aliuliza ningekuja lini.

checks.question: Badilisha: Baba alisema, "Nitarudi kesho."
checks.answer: Baba alisema kwamba angerudi siku iliyofuata.

checks.question: Swali la usemi wa taarifa huishia kwa alama gani?
